import numpy as np
def equation(eps, T, params):
    p = params
    a = p[0] + p[1]*T + p[2]/T
    b = p[3] + p[4]*T + p[5]/T
    return a + b/eps + p[6]*eps**p[7] + p[8]*eps**2 + p[9]*T*eps
